name: sidebar-08
title: Sidebar 08
description: A sidebar with collapsible sections, projects with a dropdown menu, secondary nav, and a user menu.

files.content:
export type NavIconName =
  | "square-terminal"
  | "bot"
  | "book-open"
  | "settings"
  | "life-buoy"
  | "send"
  | "frame"
  | "pie-chart"
  | "map";

export interface Input {
  name: NavIconName;
  class?: string;
}

<const/className=input.class ?? "size-4"/>

<if=input.name === "square-terminal">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="m7 11 2-2-2-2"/>
    <path d="M11 13h4"/>
    <rect width="18" height="18" x="3" y="3" rx="2" ry="2"/>
  </svg>
</if>
<else if=input.name === "bot">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="M12 8V4H8"/>
    <rect width="16" height="12" x="4" y="8" rx="2"/>
    <path d="M2 14h2"/>
    <path d="M20 14h2"/>
    <path d="M15 13v2"/>
    <path d="M9 13v2"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else if=input.name === "book-open">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="M12 7v14"/>
    <path d="M3 18a1 1 0 0 1-1-1V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h5a4 4 0 0 1 4 4 4 4 0 0 1 4-4h5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v13a1 1 0 0 1-1 1h-6a3 3 0 0 0-3 3 3 3 0 0 0-3-3z"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else if=input.name === "settings">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="M20 7h-9"/>
    <path d="M14 17H5"/>
    <circle cx="17" cy="17" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="7" cy="7" r="3"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else if=input.name === "life-buoy">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/>
    <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/>
    <line x1="4.93" x2="9.17" y1="4.93" y2="9.17"/>
    <line x1="14.83" x2="19.07" y1="14.83" y2="19.07"/>
    <line x1="14.83" x2="19.07" y1="9.17" y2="4.93"/>
    <line x1="14.83" x2="18.36" y1="9.17" y2="5.64"/>
    <line x1="4.93" x2="9.17" y1="19.07" y2="14.83"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else if=input.name === "send">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="M3.714 3.048a.498.498 0 0 0-.683.627l2.843 7.627a2 2 0 0 1 0 1.396l-2.842 7.627a.498.498 0 0 0 .682.627l18-8.5a.5.5 0 0 0 0-.904z"/>
    <path d="M6 12h16"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else if=input.name === "frame">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <line x1="22" x2="2" y1="6" y2="6"/>
    <line x1="22" x2="2" y1="18" y2="18"/>
    <line x1="6" x2="6" y1="2" y2="22"/>
    <line x1="18" x2="18" y1="2" y2="22"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else if=input.name === "pie-chart">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="M21 12c.552 0 1.005-.449.95-.998a10 10 0 0 0-8.953-8.951c-.55-.055-.998.398-.998.95v8a1 1 0 0 0 1 1z"/>
    <path d="M21.21 15.89A10 10 0 1 1 8.11 2.79"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else if=input.name === "map">
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="M14.106 5.553a2 2 0 0 0 1.788 0l3.659-1.83A1 1 0 0 1 21 4.619v12.764a1 1 0 0 1-.553.894l-4.553 2.277a2 2 0 0 1-1.788 0l-4.212-2.106a2 2 0 0 0-1.788 0l-3.659 1.83A1 1 0 0 1 3 19.381V6.618a1 1 0 0 1 .553-.894l4.553-2.277a2 2 0 0 1 1.788 0z"/>
    <path d="M15 5.764v15"/>
    <path d="M9 3.236v15"/>
  </svg>
</else>
<else>
  <svg
    xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
    width="24"
    height="24"
    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
    fill="none"
    stroke="currentColor"
    stroke-width="2"
    stroke-linecap="round"
    stroke-linejoin="round"
    class=className
  >
    <path d="M9 18a5 5 0 1 0 0-10 5 5 0 0 0 0 10Z"/>
    <path d="M14.5 9.5 21 3"/>
    <path d="M17 3h4v4"/>
  </svg>
</else>

The source's isMobile-aware // dropdown side/align (bottom+end on mobile, right+start on desktop) has // no equivalent in our zag-based DropdownMenu input, so it is omitted; // the menu positions itself automatically.
